name: api-server-collection
description: A collection of API servers for testing

scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start-tmdb" "npm run start-anivexa" "npm run start-aniwatch" "npm run start-hianime" "npm run start-miruro" "npm run start-reanime" "npx serve . -p 8080"
scripts.start-tmdb: cd TMDB-Embed-API-main/TMDB-Embed-API-main && npx cross-env PORT=3005 API_PORT=3005 node apiServer.js
scripts.start-anivexa: cd Anivexa-API && npx cross-env PORT=4000 node server.js
scripts.start-aniwatch: cd Aniwatch-Api-main && npx cross-env PORT=4001 node src/inde.js
scripts.start-hianime: cd hianime-api-v2 && npx cross-env PORT=4002 npx --yes tsx index.ts
scripts.start-miruro: cd MiruroAPI && npx cross-env PORT=4003 FLARESOLVERR_URL=http://localhost:8191 node server.js
scripts.start-streamtv: cd streamtv-backend && npx cross-env PORT=5000 npm run dev
